data.title: Lines below the bridge
data.goal: Ask to join a walk, request a closer look and describe a detail noticed in person.

memoryNodes.cue: Who can you ask about joining the activity?
memoryNodes.cueZh: 可以向谁询问参加活动？
memoryNodes.locationRelationZh: 博物馆墙海报右侧服务门旁；向导取装备后集合出发

memoryNodes.cue: What visible detail can you ask the guide to show you?
memoryNodes.cueZh: 可以请向导指出哪个可见细节？
memoryNodes.locationRelationZh: 沿河步道低桥边，站在步道上看墙底痕迹；长椅在桥后

memoryNodes.cue: What did you notice yourself, and how can you report it?
memoryNodes.cueZh: 自己亲眼注意到什么，可以怎样描述？
memoryNodes.locationRelationZh: 越过桥后的步道长椅；返回博物馆再回旅社

data.situation: At the poster beside the museum wall, two guides were waiting with a small group. A white van stood by the service door to the right; one guide took a box of maps from it. Maya asked whether she could join the guided walk. There was room, so a guide named Nora handed her a map. The map included a picture of a low bridge. They followed the river to it. In the picture, its grey wall looked smooth. Here, Maya could hear water moving under the bridge and see pale lines near the bottom. “Could you show me those lines?” Maya asked. Nora pointed from the path. They were marks left by the water at different times. Maya wrote down what she could see and kept her question about their age for Nora. At the bench beyond the bridge, she sent Jo a short message about the on-site experience. She described the lines and the sound of the river. Before returning to the hostel, she checked the path back to the museum. This time, her note held a detail she had seen herself as well as a route.
data.zhSupport: 海报集合处 → 桥旁可见痕迹 → 桥后长椅。先询问能否加入，再请求指出细节，最后用自己实际见到的内容描述体验。装备车只作识别物件。
data.easySummary: Maya joins a walk led by a guide. She asks to see a detail on the bridge and describes what she noticed.
data.easySummaryZh: 玛雅参加向导带领的步行导览，请人指出桥上的细节，再描述自己的观察。

glossary.zh: 由向导带领的步行观光；步行导览
glossary.note: 保留原来源中由向导带领游览的意义，不把自己散步等同此活动。
glossary.example: Could I join the guided walk?
glossary.exampleZh: 我可以参加步行导览吗？
matchTexts: Could I join the guided walk?

glossary.note: 指带领他人参观地点的人，保持来源复数名词；不并入指南书或指导动词。
glossary.example: The guides were waiting beside the museum wall.
glossary.exampleZh: 向导们在博物馆墙旁等候。

glossary.zh: 厢型车；厢式货车（本事件用途）
glossary.note: 原记录包含运货或运人的车辆；这里停在服务门旁，用于运送向导装备，不安排游客乘坐。
glossary.example: The van carried the guides’ equipment.
glossary.exampleZh: 厢型车运送了向导们的装备。

glossary.note: 实地到访产生的体验。原来源以看金字塔为例；本项目另用河边导览事件，不把原句当新地点事实，也不是工作经验。
glossary.example: The on-site experience helped Maya notice the marks on the wall.
glossary.exampleZh: 现场体验让玛雅注意到了墙上的痕迹。
matchTexts: The on-site experience helped Maya notice the marks on the wall.

glossary.note: 在活动开始前询问能否加入；需等待对方确认安排。
glossary.example: Could I join the guided walk?
glossary.exampleZh: 我可以参加步行导览吗？
matchTexts: Could I join the guided walk?

glossary.note: 请求对方指出具体位置或可观察细节。
glossary.example: Could you show me the water marks on the wall?
glossary.exampleZh: 可以指给我看墙上的水痕吗？
matchTexts: Could you show me the water marks on the wall?

glossary.text: I noticed … when I was there.
glossary.note: 用可观察细节报告亲历体验，不默认对事实原因已有解释。
glossary.example: I noticed pale lines on the wall when I was there.
glossary.exampleZh: 我在现场时注意到墙上几道浅色的线。
matchTexts: I noticed pale lines on the wall when I was there.

retrievalPrompts.cue: A group is about to begin a sightseeing walk with a guide. Ask whether you may join.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 一群人准备跟向导开始步行观光。询问你能否加入。
acceptableAnswers: Could I join the guided walk?
May I join this guided walk, please?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Ask about joining the activity and leave the guide a chance to confirm the arrangement.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 明确询问能否参加，让向导确认安排。
checks: 说明是向导带领的步行观光

retrievalPrompts.cue: You can see faint lines near the bottom of the bridge wall. Ask Nora to point them out so you can understand which ones she means.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 你看到桥墙底部有浅浅的线，请诺拉指出她说的是哪几道。
acceptableAnswers: Could you show me those lines on the wall?
Could you show me the water marks near the bottom of the wall?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Name the detail or point to its position. Your question asks for a closer explanation of something visible.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 说出具体细节或所在位置，让对方知道你问哪一处。

retrievalPrompts.function: Describe a detail noticed in person
retrievalPrompts.cue: Jo asks what you noticed during the visit. Describe one visible detail and say that you saw it there yourself.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 乔问你这次参观注意到了什么。说出一个可见细节，并说明是在现场看到的。
acceptableAnswers: I noticed pale lines on the wall when I was there.
When I was there, I noticed water marks near the bottom of the bridge wall.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Give one concrete observation. You can keep a separate question for anything you still want to find out.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 给出一个具体观察；还想核实的问题可以另行提出。
checks: 说明自己在现场注意到

transferPrompt.function: Ask about a new place and report a detail
transferPrompt.cue: You visit a community garden with a volunteer. Ask them to show you the small labels beside the plants. Later, tell a friend that you noticed labels in several languages when you were there.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 你跟志愿者参观社区花园。请对方指给你看植物旁的小标签；之后告诉朋友，你在现场注意到标签使用了几种语言。
acceptableAnswers: Could you show me the labels beside the plants? I noticed labels in several languages when I was there.
Could you show me those plant labels? When I was there, I noticed that the labels were in several languages.
transferPrompt.feedback: Move both the request and the report to the garden. Use the new detail rather than repeating the bridge wall.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 把请求与观察都迁移到花园，描述新细节。
